# typola

> Probabilistic models over linguistic typology source data (WALS, Grambank, ...) with pluggable count-to-probability estimators.


## Pages

- [typola](index.html.md): Probabilistic models over linguistic typology source data (WALS, Grambank, …).
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;typola&#96;   | typola: probabilistic models over linguistic typology source data.   |
- [typola](_autosummary/typola.html.md): typola: probabilistic models over linguistic typology source data.
- [typola.sources](_autosummary/typola.sources.html.md): Descriptors and downloaders for typology datasets.
- [typola.sources.base](_autosummary/typola.sources.base.html.md): Source specification &amp; registry.
- [typola.sources.catalog](_autosummary/typola.sources.catalog.html.md): Catalog of known typology data sources.
- [typola.estimators](_autosummary/typola.estimators.html.md): Pluggable count-to-probability estimators.
- [typola.estimators.base](_autosummary/typola.estimators.base.html.md): Estimator base class + evaluation utilities.
- [typola.estimators.smoothing](_autosummary/typola.estimators.smoothing.html.md): Concrete count-to-probability estimators.

- [typola.models](_autosummary/typola.models.html.md): Probabilistic models over a &#96;Typology&#96;.
- [typola.models.conditional](_autosummary/typola.models.conditional.html.md): Conditional distribution: P(target parameter | given parameter).
- [typola.models.distribution](_autosummary/typola.models.distribution.html.md): A categorical distribution over a known support, with introspection.
- [typola.models.marginal](_autosummary/typola.models.marginal.html.md): Marginal distribution over a parameter’s support, under a condition.
- [typola.prep](_autosummary/typola.prep.html.md): Data preparation: raw source → canonical &#96;Typology&#96;.
- [typola.prep.canonical](_autosummary/typola.prep.canonical.html.md): Canonical representation of a typology dataset.
- [typola.prep.cldf](_autosummary/typola.prep.cldf.html.md): Parse a CLDF StructureDataset directory into a &#96;Typology&#96;.
- [typola.prep.loaders](_autosummary/typola.prep.loaders.html.md): High-level &#96;load()&#96; function tying sources ↔ canonical typology.
- [typola.prep.stores](_autosummary/typola.prep.stores.html.md): dol-backed stores for convenient access to prepped data.
